opening_message:
Ticket 1: Richard Davis (employee ID E011) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E011.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Richard Davis (E011) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. He requested write access to Payroll. Full-time employees may have up to write access; his role owns the Payroll system. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for E011 (Richard Davis) shows contractor with basic security training. Contractors without advanced training may have read at most; requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: There is conflicting employee information: HR notes E011 is a full-time Payroll Specialist (would allow write), while Security notes the record shows contractor with basic security training, which permits at most read access. Given the conflict, I apply the more restrictive policy: contractor without advanced training → maximum is read. Requested write exceeds this maximum, so grant read.
